## Orlando Family Theme Park Adventure (November 10-15, 2024)

This 6-day, 5-night itinerary for two adults and two children (ages 8 and 12) focuses on experiencing the magic of Disney World and the thrills of Universal Studios within a $4000 budget for accommodation and activities. It balances park visits with more relaxed activities and includes budget-conscious dining suggestions.

### Itinerary: Parks, Magic & Fun

**Day 1: Sunday, November 10 – Arrival & Disney Springs Discovery**
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/geo-alt.svg
- **Morning:** Arrive at Orlando International Airport (MCO), pick up rental car, and check into your pre-booked off-site accommodation.
- **Afternoon:** Settle in and head to Disney Springs for a relaxed afternoon of exploration. Enjoy window shopping, people-watching, and the vibrant atmosphere.
- **Food:** Casual dinner at one of Disney Springs' many quick-service options like Earl of Sandwich or Blaze Pizza.
Action: [Button: Explore Disney Springs] https://www.disneysprings.com/

**Day 2: Monday, November 11 – Magic Kingdom Magic**
- **Morning:** Arrive early for park opening at Magic Kingdom. Focus on Fantasyland rides (It's a Small World, Peter Pan's Flight), Adventureland, and Frontierland (Splash Mountain, Big Thunder Mountain Railroad).
- **Afternoon:** Enjoy the afternoon parade, explore Tomorrowland (Space Mountain, Buzz Lightyear's Space Ranger Spin), and Liberty Square (Haunted Mansion).
- **Food:** Quick-service lunch at Pecos Bill Tall Tale Inn and Cafe. Dinner at Cosmic Ray's Starlight Cafe for character entertainment and classic park food.
Action: [Button: Magic Kingdom Tickets] https://www.disneyworld.disney.go.com/tickets/

**Day 3: Tuesday, November 12 – Universal Studios Florida Adventures**
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/film.svg
- **Morning:** Head to Universal Studios Florida. Experience the Wizarding World of Harry Potter – Diagon Alley, including Harry Potter and the Escape from Gringotts.
- **Afternoon:** Explore other popular attractions like Despicable Me Minion Mayhem, Transformers: The Ride 3D, and Revenge of the Mummy. Don't miss the Hollywood Rip Ride Rockit if your family enjoys thrill rides.
- **Food:** Lunch at the Leaky Cauldron in Diagon Alley for a themed experience. Dinner at Mel's Drive-In for classic American fare.
Action: [Button: Universal Studios Tickets] https://www.universalorlando.com/web/en/us/tickets-packages/parks/universal-studios-florida

**Day 4: Wednesday, November 13 – Islands of Adventure Thrills**
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/lightning-charge.svg
- **Morning:** Explore Universal's Islands of Adventure. Start with The Wizarding World of Harry Potter – Hogsmeade and ride Hagrid's Magical Creatures Motorbike Adventure (arrive early!).
- **Afternoon:** Discover Jurassic Park River Adventure, The Incredible Hulk Coaster, and The Amazing Adventures of Spider-Man.
- **Food:** Lunch at Three Broomsticks in Hogsmeade. For dinner, consider CityWalk's quick-service options for variety.
Action: [Button: Islands of Adventure Tickets] https://www.universalorlando.com/web/en/us/tickets-packages/parks/islands-of-adventure

**Day 5: Thursday, November 14 – Relaxation & Local Fun**
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/sun.svg
- **Morning:** Enjoy a leisurely morning at your accommodation, perhaps swimming in the hotel pool or having a late breakfast.
- **Afternoon:** Choose a budget-friendly activity:
    - **Option 1:** Mini Golf at Pirate's Cove Adventure Golf.
    - **Option 2:** Explore ICON Park for some free entertainment, then consider a ride on The Wheel (optional, additional cost).
- **Food:** Pack a picnic lunch or enjoy an affordable meal at a local diner. For dinner, try a family-friendly restaurant near your accommodation.
